value.rationale: Convex regression is a standard, mathematically motivated shape-constrained nearest-point map. The theorem computes a natural sharp worst-coordinate amplification invariant in its smallest nontrivial interior-extremizer size; it identifies a genuinely nonconsecutive two-contact mechanism that strictly outperforms the maximally pooled affine fit (11/7 versus 7/5), and proves the mechanism persists for arbitrarily many observations. The value is the first qualitative extremizer transition and exact worst-case bounded-error guarantee, not generic active-set enumeration.
